photos.name: baking-in-dutch-oven
photos.summary: Two birote rolls baking in a dutch oven on parchment paper during the uncovered browning phase. Rolls show good oven spring with lengthwise scores opened wide. Crust is light golden, still developing color.

photos.name: cooling-on-rack
photos.summary: Two finished birote rolls cooling on a round wire rack, shot from above. Deep golden-brown to dark crust with heavy flour dusting. Lengthwise scores opened cleanly showing dark caramelized interior. Torpedo shape with tapered ends visible.

photos.name: crumb-shot
photos.summary: Hand holding a broken birote roll showing the crumb structure. Open, irregular holes throughout with a mix of large and medium alveoli. Crumb is light and airy with a thin but defined crust edge. Second roll visible on wire rack in background.

photos.name: dipping-in-sauce
photos.summary: Birote roll being dipped into a small bowl of dark chile salsa on a white plate — torta ahogada style. Crust shows golden-brown color with flour dusting. The bread is holding its structure against the sauce.
